description: WHERE comparison/logic matrix, ROW_NUMBER/RANK/DENSE_RANK (single and combined), and QUALIFY pre-projection windows over base expressions, deep aliases and grouped windows. Converted 1:1 from query/WhereClauseTest, WindowFunctionsTest and WindowQualifyPreProjectionTest (all now retired; tie-ambiguous ROW_NUMBER cells gained a name tie-break in the window ORDER BY for determinism).

CREATE TABLE feed_files (doc VARCHAR, fname VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO feed_files VALUES ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230629.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230630.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230705.gz')

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc ORDER BY fname DESC) AS rnk, fname
FROM feed_files s
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY GET(SPLIT(s.fname, '/'), 2) ORDER BY s.fname DESC) = 1
ORDER BY fname
CREATE TABLE feed_files (doc VARCHAR, fname VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO feed_files VALUES ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230629.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230630.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230705.gz')

SELECT REPLACE(GET(SPLIT(s.fname, '/'), 2), '.gz') AS piece,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc ORDER BY piece DESC) AS rnk
FROM feed_files s
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc, piece ORDER BY s.fname DESC) = 1
ORDER BY piece
CREATE TABLE feed_files (doc VARCHAR, fname VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO feed_files VALUES ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230629.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230630.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230705.gz')

SELECT fname, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc ORDER BY fname DESC) AS rnk
FROM feed_files s
QUALIFY rnk = 1
CREATE TABLE feed_files (doc VARCHAR, fname VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO feed_files VALUES ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230629.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230630.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230705.gz')

SELECT UPPER(fname) AS shout, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fname) AS rnk
FROM feed_files s
QUALIFY shout LIKE '%20230630%'
CREATE TABLE feed_files (doc VARCHAR, fname VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO feed_files VALUES ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230629.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230630.gz'), ('d1', 'a/b/x-20230705.gz')

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fname) AS rnk
FROM feed_files s
QUALIFY s.fname != 'a/b/x-20230630.gz'
ORDER BY rnk
CREATE TABLE sales (region VARCHAR, amt NUMBER)
INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('e', 10), ('e', 20), ('w', 5)

SELECT region, SUM(amt) AS total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rk
FROM sales GROUP BY region
QUALIFY rk = 1
